notes: 2026-02-08 continuation: stricter IRJ activation sweep around promoted bs17k_n11 discovered stronger candidate bs19k_n12. Added variants with stale_us in [17k,18k,19k] and stale_streak_n in [11,12]. Broad120 winner bs19k_n12 showed max p50/p95 regressions 1.017/1.032. Full200 confirmation (benchmarks/irj_n11_strict_full200): M4_TimeSyncPolicy:r14_irj_bs19k_n12_b50_c15k_age20s_sm50k achieved max p50 ratio 1.013 (E13), max p95 ratio 1.026 (E78), with E72 p50 0.942, E78 p50 1.000, E82 p50 1.000, E108 p50 0.940, E130 p50 1.000. comments.author: catid
comments.text:
Additional continuation on non-IRJ/ramp-discriminator tuning (2026-02-08):

Targeted triage runs (E72/E78/E108, seeds=80) and broad core sweep (64 scenarios x 40 seeds) were run for fs16 family discriminator gates around:
`r14_irj_bs15k_n17_b40_c12p5k_age20s_i6k_d45k_sm50k_fs16_t40k_d50k`

Tested gates:
- bilateral stale growth: g250, g1k
- bilateral rise-both: rb1u25, rb1u50, rb2u50
- combined: g1k_rb2u50
- rtt-delta-growth: dg3k, dg5k

Observed behavior:
- g1k / rb2u50 / g1k_rb2u50 mostly collapse to ctrl-like behavior (remove E72 benefit)
- rb1u25/rb1u50 improve E78 p95 in targeted run, but introduce broad regressions (max >5%, especially E108 p50)
- g250 gives no useful improvement over current candidate
- dg3k/dg5k are effectively no-op against current candidate

Conclusion remains unchanged: no tested discriminator beat the current promoted fast-streak profile on broad balance.

comments.author: catid
comments.text:
Continuation (2026-02-08): evaluated three additional fs16 families and none beat current promoted candidate  on broad40.

Runs:
- benchmarks/tune_fs16_capshape40 (ctrl/base/c10 + cap-shaping x2p5k variants)
- benchmarks/tune_fs16_excess40 (ctrl/base/c10 + stale-excess blend scaling variants)
- benchmarks/tune_fs16_sk40 (ctrl/base/c10 + stale-proportional cap sk50/sk70)

Findings:
- cap-shaping x2p5k variants were effectively identical to c10 behavior (no net broad improvement).
- stale-excess blend variants were no-op versus base for tested settings (identical medians across scenarios).
- sk50/sk70 reduced E78 p50 but lost E72 gain and increased E13/E108 regressions (max_reg95 ~1.033-1.035), therefore rejected.

Conclusion: keep current promoted fs16_t40k_d50k profile as best broad compromise; no promotion change from this pass.

title: TimeSync Mixture-of-Experts (Anchor + Tracker)
description:
Implement Mixture-of-Experts (anchor baseline + gated drift tracker) with strict stability gates.

Subtasks:
- Anchor estimator: baseline min-based offset.
- Tracker: (offset_track, skew_track) updated from offset_fast when stable.
- Gating: require short-window stability, enough samples, RTTGuard stable, optional XOR clock-like gate.
- Output: switch to tracker when confident or blend with weight w.
- Step handling: if StepReset triggers, re-seed tracker and hold off updates.

Tuning plan:
- Kp {0.1, 0.2, 0.4}, Ki {0.01, 0.02, 0.05}.
- Blend w {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}.
- Stability gates per GSP settings.
- Validate E0–E6 baseline preservation + E7 improvement.

Acceptance:
- Document in bench/MOE_SWEEP.md with E0/E4/E5/E7 summaries.

title: Design monotonicity/phase detector to separate E72 ramp from E78 flap for policy-GSP
description: Current GSP/IRJ gates (guard-fail EWMA, rtt-jump streak/sign, IQR floor, persistence n) cannot preserve E72 gains without severe E78 overfire. Need a detector using temporal structure (monotonic phase length, sign-flip density, or low-frequency trend vs high-frequency flap energy) and wire it as a precondition for GSP/stale-lift activation.
notes: 2026-02-08 follow-up: continued work showed non-GSP IRJ retunes outperform GSP/phase approaches for all-scenario safety. Phase/GSP family still has structural heavy-tail/reorder risk, while new IRJ n11 bounded candidate (r14_irj_bs15k_n11_b50_c15k_age20s_sm50k) achieves broad80 max p50/p95 regressions <= ~4.7% with strong E72 improvement. Suggest treating 6ok7x as lower-priority exploratory path unless a specific GSP-only objective remains.
close_reason: Implemented and evaluated phase/monotonicity detector path; broad sweeps show policy-GSP family remains structurally unsafe (heavy-tail/reorder failures). Work product captured in code + notes; follow-on optimization now centered on bounded IRJ candidates.

- Compute rtt_short = C2S_p10_short + S2C_p10_short (or p0/p10).

Tuning plan:
- rtt_guard {50us, 150us, 300us}.
- rtt_short window {2s, 4s, 8s}.
- Validate on E6_path_change and E5_reorder_dup to ensure guards fire.

title: TimeSync Age-Compensated Minima
description:
Implement Age-Compensated Minima (ACM): adjust min_long by skew*age without changing min selection.

Subtasks:
- Track t_min_long per direction (from long bins).
- Compute age = now - t_min_long; min_adj = min_long + r_dir * age.
- Use skew from CSE; if skew invalid → use baseline (r_dir=0).
- Combine with RTTGuard to freeze skew when network unstable.

Tuning plan:
- Skew_beta {0.02,0.05,0.1}, S_MAX {200,500ppm}.
- Age clamp {5s, 10s, 30s}.
- Validate E7 drift improvement; ensure E0/E4/E5 unchanged.

Acceptance:
- Document in bench/ACM_SWEEP.md with E0/E4/E5/E7 summaries.
notes: Implemented M4_TimeSyncAgeComp (ACM) using CSE skew, age clamp, and variants (age5s/age30s/b0.02/b0.10). Benchmarked run_agecomp_20260203_000500: E0/E4/E5 avg p95 0/16/52, E7 avg 4496 (regresses vs baseline 3361). Variants identical; skew likely inactive. Documented in bench/ACM_SWEEP.md and summary.
close_reason: Implemented ACM and benchmarked; docs updated. E7 regression remains.

title: TimeSync Long-Window Bins + Short Stats
description:
Implement long-window min bins + short-window stats (p0/p10/IQR/near_hits) as reusable building blocks for drift/step detectors.

Subtasks:
- Add per-second bins for long window L: bin_min, bin_time, bin_count.
- Implement O(1) update per packet and query min_long + age_long.
- Add short-window S stats: p0/p10/p25/p75, IQR, count_short, near_hits against min_long.
- Provide API to compute stats every S seconds with minimal overhead.

Tuning plan:
- L {30s, 60s, 120s}, S {1s, 2s, 4s}.
- Ensure stats stable under E4/E5 (outlier bursts) and inexpensive in CPU/mem.

Acceptance:
- Add a small debug report or CSV columns for p10/IQR/near_hits to validate correctness.
- Document in bench/SHORT_STATS_VALIDATION.md with a sample run.
close_reason: Implemented long-window bins + short-window stats with CSV columns (p10/IQR/near_hits) and validation run in bench/SHORT_STATS_VALIDATION.md.

title: TimeSync Step Detection + RTTGuarded Reset
description:
Implement step detection + RTTGuarded StepReset for fast clock step recovery without E6 regressions.

Subtasks:
- Compute offset_fast = (C2S_p10_short - S2C_p10_short)/2.
- Maintain offset_est (current) and optional skew_est.
- innovation = offset_fast - offset_pred; robust scale via MAD/RMS.
- Step trigger: |innov| >= step_th for M consecutive seconds AND RTTGuard says stable.
- Action: flush min bins, set offset_est to median(last 3 offset_fast), freeze skew updates for holdoff.

Tuning plan:
- step_min {0.2ms, 0.5ms, 2ms}, M {2,3,4}.
- rtt_guard {50us,150us,300us}, holdoff {2s,5s}.
- Validate E7 step recovery + no false triggers in E6.

Acceptance:
- Document in bench/STEP_GUARD_SWEEP.md with E7 step metrics + E6 false-positive rate.
close_reason: Implemented M4_TimeSyncStepGuard (step detection + RTTGuard reset) and ran sweep; documented in bench/STEP_GUARD_SWEEP.md; summary updated (E7 regression).

title: Validate n16_sm50k against E13 path-change tradeoff and tune if needed
description: After promoting n16_b40_sm50k in peer_bench variants, verify whether the observed ~4.7% E13 median difference vs n17_sm50k is persistent at higher seed counts and whether a small guard/bilateral tweak can recover E13 without reintroducing E36/E78 regressions.
notes: 2026-02-08 tuning pass: evaluated n16 near-hit gates (nm1/nm2/nm5), dynamic fast-streak families, and growth-gated families with focus80 and broad50 sweeps. Near-hit and initial fast-streak settings collapsed to n16 behavior; growth settings disabled IRJ and were rejected. Found robust compromise variant: r14_irj_bs15k_n17_b40_c12p5k_age20s_i6k_d45k_sm50k_fs16_t40k_d50k. It preserves n17 E13/E72 behavior while fixing E78 and improving E36. Broad50 (run_irj_fastdelta_highthr_broad50_20260208_022113): vs ctrl => E13 0.179 (same as n17), E72 0.990 (same as n17), E78 1.000 (improved from 1.024), E36 1.002 (improved from 1.006), E82/E108 1.000, max_reg 1.002. Focus80 confirms same direction: E13 retained, E78/E36 improved, no E82/E108 penalty. Pruned dead-end variants from BuildMethodVariants and kept only n17_sm50k baseline, n17_sm50k_fs16_t40k_d50k candidate, and n16_sm50k reference.

comments.author: catid
comments.text:
Continued IRJ fast-streak tuning sweep around promoted candidate `r14_irj_bs15k_n17_b40_c12p5k_age20s_i6k_d45k_sm50k_fs16_t40k_d50k`.

What was tested (all on current head):
- E72/E78/E108 targeted triage at 80 seeds for variants:
  - +bilateral growth gate (`g250`, `g1k`)
  - +rise-both gates (`rb1u25`, `rb1u50`, `rb2u50`)
  - combined growth+rise gate (`g1k_rb2u50`)
  - +RTT delta growth gates (`dg3k`, `dg5k`)
- Broad core sweep (64 scenarios x 40 seeds) for full fs16 family vs ctrl:
  - outputs: `benchmarks/run_fs16_family_broad40.csv`, `benchmarks/run_fs16_ctrl_broad40.csv`

Key outcomes:
- `dg3k`/`dg5k` are no-ops versus current promoted candidate on tested scenarios.
- `g1k`/`rb2u50`/`g1k_rb2u50` effectively disable IRJ benefit (collapse back near ctrl).
- `rb1u25`/`rb1u50` reduce E78 p95 in targeted runs but introduce worse regressions (notably E108 p50, and broad40 max regressions >5%).
- `g250` provides no meaningful gain over ctrl/candidate.

Current conclusion:
- No tested gate beats existing promoted profile on broad balance.
- Keep `r14_irj_bs15k_n17_b40_c12p5k_age20s_i6k_d45k_sm50k_fs16_t40k_d50k` as best available compromise for now.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: Follow-up note: attempted additional fs16 guard-shaping variants while exploring broader robustness (cap-shaping extra-cap, stale-excess blend, stale-k=0.5/0.7). None outperformed promoted  on broad40; results parked under benchmarks/tune_fs16_capshape40, benchmarks/tune_fs16_excess40, benchmarks/tune_fs16_sk40.

title: TimeSync Shadow Window + Promotion
description:
Implement a "Shadow Window" TimeSync variant with promotion logic to handle step/path changes without reacting to outliers.

Subtasks:
- Add MethodKind (e.g., M4_TimeSyncShadow).
- Maintain long min window (baseline) and short shadow min window.
- Update rule:
  - If short < long: update long immediately (path improved).
  - If short > long + guard_band: increment promote counter.
  - When promote counter >= N, promote short -> long.
- Add params: short_window_us, long_window_us, guard_band_us, promote_count.

Tuning plan:
- Sweep short_window_us {0.5s, 1s, 2s, 5s}.
- Sweep guard_band_us {50, 100, 200}.
- Sweep promote_count {2, 3, 4, 5}.
- Keep long_window_us {20s, 60s}.
- Validate E4/E5 stability + E7 step recovery.

Acceptance:
- Document in bench/SHADOW_WINDOW_SWEEP.md with E0/E4/E5/E7 summaries.
- Update BENCHMARK_SUMMARY.md with best variant and regressions.
notes: Augment with GSP gates/ablations: add short-window stats (p0/p10/IQR, near_hits) and require (enough_samples, stable_short, no_near, age_ok) before promotion. Add optional clock-like XOR gate (stale_C2S XOR stale_S2C). Add RTTGuard to suppress promotion when rtt_short unstable. Promote using p10 (not p0). Sweep: N_CONSEC {2..5}, NPKT_MIN {20,50,100}, GB from max(50us,4*(p10-p0)), IQR_MAX {200us, 10*(p10-p0)}, GNEAR {25us, 2*(p10-p0)}, age_ok {3s,10s}.
close_reason: Implemented M4_TimeSyncShadow (GSP) with gates/XOR/RTT options, custom min/offset pipeline, and sweep results in bench/SHADOW_WINDOW_SWEEP.md; summary updated.

title: TimeSync Tilted-Min (sloped floor)
description:
Implement Tilted-Min (sloped floor) using coupled skew estimate to compensate drift in min computation.

Subtasks:
- Use skew from CSE (or other estimator) to compute r_dir = ±skew.
- For each packet: tilted = delta - r_dir * t.
- Maintain long-window min over tilted values; reconstruct min_est(now)=min_tilted + r_dir*now.
- Combine with StepReset (from TimeSync-jew6) or GSP to handle steps.

Tuning plan:
- L {30s, 60s}, skew_beta {0.02,0.05,0.1}, S_MAX {200,500ppm}.
- Validate E7 drift sawtooth, check E0/E4/E5 regressions.

Acceptance:
- Document in bench/TILTED_MIN_SWEEP.md with E0/E4/E5/E7 summaries.
notes: Implemented M4_TimeSyncTilted (tilted-min) with coupled skew estimator (CSE), added variants (b0.02/b0.10/max200/net2). Benchmarked run_tilted_20260202_235000: E0/E4/E5 avg p95 0/16/52, E7 avg 4496 (regresses vs baseline 3361). Variants identical; CSE likely not updating enough. Documented in bench/TILTED_MIN_SWEEP.md and summary.

title: TimeSync Consensus-Slope (Hough-style) Filter
description:
Implement a consensus-slope / Hough-style robust filter to estimate drift and offset from packet deltas while rejecting reorder/dup outliers.

Subtasks:
- Add MethodKind (e.g., M4_TimeSyncConsensus).
- Maintain buffer of last K candidate points near current min (e.g., within X% of min).
- Build slope histogram from (oldest, newest) or pairwise samples; pick dominant slope as skew.
- Project points to now using slope; choose low-percentile (e.g., 1–10%) as offset estimate.
- Clamp slope (ppm) to sane bounds.

Tuning plan:
- Sweep buffer size K {32, 64, 128}.
- Candidate threshold {5%, 10%, 20%} of min.
- Slope bin width {1, 2, 5 ppm}.
- Percentile {1%, 5%, 10%}.
- Validate E4/E5 robustness + E7 drift tracking.

Acceptance:
- Document in bench/CONSENSUS_SLOPE_SWEEP.md with E0/E4/E5/E7 summaries.
- Update BENCHMARK_SUMMARY.md with best variant and regressions.
